{"ops": [{"insert": "创造新市场，做到300万+用户：Bubble创始人的10年长征"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 1}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": {"image": "https://i.imgur.com/Ia9JHbc.png"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你有没有想过——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " create 一个全新的市场类别，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "是什么感觉？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Emmanuel Straschnov正在做这件事。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Bubble——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " no-code development platform。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "300万+用户。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "年收入2000万到1亿美元之间。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们花了10年时间 educate the market。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这是他们的故事。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【商学院毕业，但不会编程】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Emmanuel比很多同龄人晚进入创业，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "而且没有技术背景。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但他不后悔 unconventional path——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "它给了他 broad perspective 和 adaptability，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "在 navigate startup world 时 crucial。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "当他 eventually get started，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "一切都 happen very quickly。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "那是2012年。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他刚商学院毕业。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Startup 时代正在起飞。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "很多 domain experts 缺乏 coding skills build their products，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "所以他们都在找 CTO。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他知道这种 pain。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他一直在 neighboring engineering school 闲逛"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " meet possible technical cofounders。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "然后，他遇到了 Josh。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他正要 say yes 一个全职工作，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但工作 offer 过期的前一天和 Josh 有了第一次 coffee，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " Josh pitched 这个想法给他。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们决定一起建 Bubble！"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他不是说这是人们应该怎么做的方式，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但在他们 case，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " it worked out great。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【跳过验证，直接开干】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Josh 看到了机会——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "市场缺口。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们都相信，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "随着技术变得更 integral to our lives，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " no-code solutions 的需求会 grow。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们没有通过 rigorous process validate 想法。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们 confident simplifying coding 会是 inherently valuable，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " despite early skepticism from others。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们有 conviction，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "因为知道 democratizing software development"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " could unleash a wave of innovation。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "有人可能会说他不 validated product 就拒绝工作是 risky，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但他不这么认为。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这就是 bootstrap 的好处——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们有 flexibility explore and validate as they went"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " without fear of disappointing investors。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Real validation 来自——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "当他们 secured first paying customers"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " and saw them successfully using Bubble"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " build their applications。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "后来，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "当 users 开始 recommend Bubble to others"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " and even build on behalf of the ecosystem，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " they knew they were onto something meaningful。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【创始人都得会编程】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他坚信在 start marketing 之前有 solid、robust product。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "对像 Bubble 这么 technical 的产品，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "两个 founders 都需要 work on product，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "所以他学会了编程。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他已经知道一点。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "最初的编程经验来自青少年时期——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " MS-DOS 和 Windows 95，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "大学时学了一些计算机科学。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但 Josh 真的成了他的老师。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他还用书籍补充。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们 avoid 了 React 和 Angular 等流行框架。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "然而，在适用的地方 leverage open-source projects。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "具体来说，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们的后端用 Node.js 建的，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "数据库跑在 Postgres 上。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "学会编程的最大好处是——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "帮他 build a lot of empathy for their customers"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " who were faced with similar tradeoffs。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这就是他们建 Bubble 的原因——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这样人们就不必经历学编程的过程"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "才能开始他们的 businesses。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Eventually，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他 transitioned out of code。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "现在，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他 focus 在 strategic leadership、hiring the right team、"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " making sure everyone is aligned、"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " exploring new growth opportunities。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Incredibly rewarding。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【 Bubble 是什么？】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Bubble 在 development 行业的 no-code 细分市场运营。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "它是 programming platform，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " enable anyone build and launch applications"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " without needing write code。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Rather than specialize in one or two aspects of development，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " like designing landing pages or building databases，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " Bubble's full-stack interface does it all。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这意味着任何人——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "从 first-time entrepreneurs 到 enterprise-level companies——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "可以从 concept 到 fully functional、scalable reality 更快更便宜"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " than you could with just code。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们的商业模式是 subscription-based，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "提供 various pricing tiers meet diverse needs of their users。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们还提供免费计划让用户 explore platform，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " option upgrade to paid plans"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " for additional features、capacity、and support。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "此外，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们通过 marketplace 产生收入，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " users 可以在那里购买其他 Bubble users 创建的"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " templates、plugins、and services，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " fostering vibrant ecosystem"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " enhance platform's functionality。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们不 share revenue 具体数字，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但可以说年收入在2000万到1亿美元之间。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【做不可扩展的事】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "虽然他们在5年后拿了 funding，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但他们最初 bootstrap Bubble。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "之前工作的 savings 允许他们俩全职工作同时建 MVP。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "六个月内，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们 secured first paying customers，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "一年后，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " revenue covered most of their costs，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "允许他们拿 modest salaries。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这段时间，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们做了完全不可扩展的事情。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他每天至少花一小时在 Skype 上，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "和他们的 first customer's developer 屏幕分享，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "理解他们 trying achieve 什么，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " figure out best way do it。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这种 kind of thing 是非常 powerful 的方式"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " ensure you're building something that works for users……"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " as long as your first users are representative"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " of the persona you're building for。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【不要太早公开发布】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他相信太早公开发布——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "比如在 Product Hunt、TechCrunch 等——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " can be a mistake。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "虽然 early user feedback valuable，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " well-timed、impactful launch 可以 make significant difference。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Premature visibility 经常 fail translate into effective user conversion。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Taking the time refine your product and strategy"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " can lead to more successful and sustainable growth trajectory。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但重要的是注意——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""launching" 真的不同于 putting your product in front of customers。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "早期，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " getting high-quality feedback critical"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " and you have to put your product in front of people to get it。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们在2015年10月通过 ProductHunt 获得第一次 major exposure，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但他们在2012年就开始获得付费客户了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他的观点是——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " until you have a stable product，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " fewer customers with more in-depth feedback"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " is better than many customers with shallow feedback。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "一旦你 consistently see genuine enthusiasm，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " your product effectively solves a real problem，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " and you have clear strategy for marketing、support、and scaling，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " you're ready launch to wider audience。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【先行者优势】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们最大的优势之一是他们 early——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们是 no-code 空间 first to market 的之一。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们10多年前就开始了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这给了他们 build credibility、"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " establish strong brand、"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " grow enthusiastic community、"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " refine product、"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " build strong foundation for growth 所需的 time。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "话虽如此，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " create a new category 很困难。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他认为每个 founder 在 take first version to customers for feedback 时"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "都面临一定程度的 skepticism，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " to some degree。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但这是 next level。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们不得不 educate the market。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "很多人无法 grasp complex applications"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " could be built without traditional coding 的想法。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "更不用说 technical community、"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "或传统 coders，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "经常 view WYSIWYG solutions with suspicion，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " doubting they could match what could be done with code。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "所以他们 focus 在 refining their product、"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " expanding what it could do、"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " educating the market，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "慢慢地但 surely，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " community started see benefits of no-code development。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【通过 meetups 找到第一批用户】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Being early 的另一个挑战是——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "有我们今天没有的技术限制。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但他们的 early growth approach 帮助应对了这一点。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2012年，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "纽约到处都是 domain experts"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " trying launch venture"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " and looking for tech cofounders help them build product。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们会去 meetups match technical 和 non-technical founders。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "那就是他们找到 first users 的地方。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们找不到 tech cofounder，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但找到了 Bubble。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "In person 完成 really helpful。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "它创造了必要的 trust，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "既然他们在纽约，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "能够经常 in person meet refine product"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " when they hit limitations。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【7年不花钱营销】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们直到2019年才 invest in marketing。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "前7年，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们 prioritized product development 和 community building。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们的策略是——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " create a product people loved"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " and let organic growth through word-of-mouth"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " drive initial adoption。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这个 approach 允许他们 refine Bubble based on real user feedback"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " and build loyal user base"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " without significant marketing spend。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们的策略 focus 在——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " create exciting product"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " and fostering community through Bubble Forum。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这听起来 cheesy，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但建 users feel emotionally connected to 的东西"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " because they have friends they've made"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " or their requested feature was built into the product——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " that is the best way get users at first。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【后期增长：内容营销】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "到他们决定 invest in marketing 的时候，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们已经有 mature product 和 strong community，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " making their marketing efforts more effective。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "现在，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们 invest in content marketing、community、product marketing、"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " education、paid advertising、"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " and partnerships with influencers"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " in tech and startup communities。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们还 focus 在 enhancing website 和 onboarding experience"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " convert visitors into active users more effectively。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Content marketing 和 partnerships 到目前为止最成功。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们 drive high-quality traffic and engagement。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Paid advertising 时好时坏；"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " while it brings in leads，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " conversion rate varies，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " highlighting importance of targeting and messaging。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他最喜欢的 marketing initiatives 之一是 user conference，BubbleCon。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "去年第一次做。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Incredible see people from all over the world"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " who had become close on the forum"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " meet in person for the first time。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他 excited be doing it again in October。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "当谈到 marketing strategies，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " really just about continuous experimentation and optimization。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【社区变成生态系统】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们的社区2015年从 simple forum 开始。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Fostering community in Bubble Forum 一直是他们策略的 cornerstone。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他过去常常 evenings responding to each post。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "It allowed him get really close with many of their users"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " and those are relationships he values to this day。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "几个月后，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他开始看到人们互相 respond，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " helping each other，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " sometimes arguing（in a nice way!）"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " about the best solution to their challenges。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这 surprised him——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " underscored importance of the community"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " and significance of what they were building。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "现在，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们通过 recognize and reward active contributors、"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " highlighting user success stories、"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " aiming keep the forum valuable resource"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " for learning and support drive engagement。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "那个 community 现在已经 evolve into ecosystem。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "多亏了他们在2016年 launch 的 marketplace。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "

content_en: Creating New Market Achieving 3M+ Users: Bubble Founder's 10-Year Journey. Have you thought about creating brand new market category feels like? Emmanuel Straschnov is doing this. Bubble no-code development platform. 3M+ users. Annual revenue between $20M-$100M. They spent 10 years educating the market. This is their story. Business school graduate but can't code. Emmanuel entered entrepreneurship later than many peers without technical background. But he doesn't regret unconventional path: it gave him broad perspective and adaptability crucial navigating startup world. When he eventually get started everything happened very quickly. It was 2012. Just graduated from business school. Startup era taking off. Many domain experts lack coding skills building startups.
content_jp: 新しい市場を作成して300万以上のユーザーに到達：Bubble創業者の10年の旅。全く新しい市場カテゴリーを作成することが 어떤 느낌か考えたことある？Emmanuel Straschnov是这样做的。Bubble—no-code開発プラットフォーム。300万以上のユーザー。年間収益は2000万から1億ドルの間。市場に教育するのに10年費やした。これは彼らの物語。ビジネススクール卒但是不會コード。Emmanuelは多くの同龄人より遅くスタートアップに入った、技術的背景がなくても。でも彼は unconventional pathを後悔していない——それは broad perspective と adaptability を彼に与え、スタートアップワールドをナビゲートする際に重要だった。結局始めるとなったとき、すべてが非常に素早く起こった。2012年だった。ビジネススクールを 졸업したばかり。スタートアップ时代が本格化して。许多领域专家缺乏编码技能来建立创业公司。
content_ar: خلق سوق جديد تحقيق 3 ملايين+ مستخدم: رحلة مؤسس Bubble لمدة 10 سنوات. هل فكرت في إنشاء فئة سوق جديدة تمامًا كيف يشعر؟ إيمانويلستراسشناف يفعل هذا. Bubble منصة تطوير بدون كود. 3 ملايين+ مستخدم. الإيرادات السنوية بين 20 مليون-100 مليون دولار. أمضوا 10 سنوات تثقيف السوق. هذه قصتهم. خريج كلية أعمال لكنه لا يستطيع الترميز. دخل إيمانويل ريادة الأعمال متأخرًا عن كثير من أقرانه بدون خلفية تقنية. لكنه لا يندم على المسار غير التقليدي: منحه منظورًا واسعًا وقدرة على التكيف أمر حيوي للتنقل في عالم الشركات الناشئة. عندما بدأ أخيرًا حدث كل شيء بسرعة كبيرة. كان في 2012. تخرج للتو من كلية الأعمال. حقبة الشركات الناشئة تنطلق. يفتقر كثير من الخبراء في المجال إلى مهارات الترميز لبناء الشركات الناشئة.
